## ecmcN6-1-1-1-S_OPT.cmd

[Source: hardware/Nanotec/ecmcN6-1-1-1-S_OPT.cmd](https://github.com/paulscherrerinstitute/ecmccfg/blob/master/hardware/Nanotec/ecmcN6-1-1-1-S_OPT.cmd)

Documented configuration options:

- RAW_POS Use 0x6063 as positionActual01; name 0x6064 positionActualScaled01, 0/1, default 0.
- HOMING Map homing parameters and sequence-26 trigger alias, 0/1, default 0.
- CAPTURE Map 3241:01..0C capture readbacks, 0/1, default 0.
- ANALOG_IN Map both 3320 analog inputs, 0/1, default 0.
